title: Cut CI wall time to about 3.5 minutes: shard E2E and rebalance the sweep shards
description: After TASK-7.8, CI run #210: sweep shard 2 took 476 s while shard 1 took 156 s (vitest --shard splits by file count, and the playtest-heavy files cluster). CI wall time went from ~4.5 to ~8 min; the 30-min job limit is still far, but every new bot test lands on the slow shard.

nodes.title: Cut CI wall time to about 3.5 minutes: shard E2E and rebalance the sweep shards
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Deal every hand from a seeded shuffle with a replay code
Play a complete fixed-limit hand from blinds to showdown
Give each deciding seat only its own view of the hand
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Compute a hand's equity against opponent hands
Recommend a preflop action from the 6-max chart
Recommend call or fold after the flop from equity and pot odds
Estimate each opponent's range from their actions in the hand
Recommend betting or raising for value

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the sweep tests on CI, When they run, Then no sweep shard takes more than about 1.5× the other (by duration, e.g. 3 shards or duration-based file assignment) and the CI wall time on main is back under about 6 min, with every sweep file still run exactly once

Given the E2E suite on CI, When it runs, Then it is split into 4 parallel jobs (2 shards per browser, Chromium and WebKit), every e2e test runs exactly once per browser, the Playwright report/artifact on failure still identifies the failing test, and no test or assertion is removed

Given a push to main after this change, When CI finishes, Then the wall time is about 3.5 minutes or less, measured on at least 2 runs (the repo is public, so the extra standard-runner jobs are not billed)

implementationNotes:
Autopilot 2026-11-25 measurement (main CI run 45677932929): wall time 5.6 min (<6 min target met); sweep shard 1 = 123 s, shard 2 = 219 s (1.8x); E2E job (5.6 min) is the critical path, so rebalancing sweeps would not shorten CI. Skipped in autopilot as no-gain; user to decide whether to keep, re-scope or drop.

2026-11-27: user chose 'Shard E2E + rebalance sweeps'. Main run 46046670509: wall 439 s; E2E job 439 s (test step 378 s, ~420 tests x 2 browsers); sweep shard 2 212 s, shard 1 147 s; unit 75 s; lint/build/playtest 62 s. Expected cost ~4-5 extra Actions minutes per run for job setup.
